dataset_metadata.name: CALCE PL Pouch Cycling Study (Partial SOC Ranges)
dataset_metadata.institution: Center for Advanced Life Cycle Engineering (CALCE), University of Maryland
dataset_metadata.citation: Saxena, S., Hendricks, C., Pecht, M. (2016). Cycle life testing and modeling of graphite/LiCoO2 cells under different state of charge ranges. Journal of Power Sources, 327, 394-400. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jpowsour.2016.07.057
dataset_metadata.funding: Supported by more than 150 companies and organizations supporting CALCE at the University of Maryland

cell_info.cell_notes: Nominal capacity rated at C/5 rate. EOC voltage 4.2 V, EOD voltage 2.75 V as specified by manufacturer. Cell label visible on photo: PL-325085-2C, 3.7V 1500mAh. Mass stated as 'without safety circuit'.

aging_modes.notes: 5 SOC ranges tested: 0-60%, 0-100%, 20-80%, 40-60%, 40-100%. Two discharge C-rates (C/2 and 2C) applied to 0-100%, 20-80%, and 40-60% ranges; only C/2 applied to 40-100% and 0-60% ranges. 2 cells per condition. Cycling defined by SOC range (Coulomb counting), not fixed voltages. Equivalent full cycles (EFC) used to normalize across partial-cycle conditions. Testing reported up to ~800 EFC for most ranges, ~450 EFC for 40-60% range.

time_protocol.notes: Temperature reported as 25 ± 2°C in a semi-temperature-controlled room. Every 50 cycles took approximately 10 days. Total_cycles_approx refers to equivalent full cycles (EFC); actual partial cycles are higher. Checkup performed every 50 or 100 cycles.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: CCV (closed-circuit voltage) recorded during positive current steps; OCV recorded when current drops to zero. SOC estimated via Coulomb counting, recalibrated every 50-100 cycles with reference capacity test.
rawdata.known_issues: Rest periods occasionally extended due to equipment unavailability, which may affect capacity measurements for some cells (noted in Fig. 4a of paper).

checkup.notes: Full capacity check performed every 50 or 100 partial cycles: CCCV charge / CC discharge at C/2 rate between fixed voltages 2.75 V and 4.2 V. Interval is 50-100 cycles; 50 used here as the minimum stated.

notes: Dataset label 'PL-Cyc' distinguishes this cycling dataset from the storage dataset ('PL-Stor') on the same cell type. The cycling protocol targets SOC windows computed by Coulomb counting rather than voltage limits, making it a variable/partial-cycle study. The charge protocol is CC-CV only for ranges reaching 100% SOC (0-100% and 40-100%); for other ranges, CC-only charge is used (but CC-CV is listed here as the overarching protocol per the characterization and initial charge procedure described in the paper). Manufacturer of the PL cell is not explicitly named in any source document.
